posts.text: Can you check off all 9 squares? Save this bingo card and see how many you can complete at your #RBRadiance Pre-Rifts!
#RBRadiance Pre-Rift is finally here! Our creators got a few rounds in at the LA Summit Pre-Rift. Here's what they had to say after their first taste of the set!
Got the right card in hand? Show it off to your opponent as you play a card to unlock an additional effect! #RBRadiance

We're coming up on one year of Riftbound, and always finding ways to level up the game! We're exploring three potential changes to turn order to help create a more balanced playing experience. These changes will be tested at events worldwide, outside of premier tournaments. Article: https://riot.com/3UvUU3M
